purpose: S072 magnetic boundary ensemble, coupled axial static response and LLL projection

sources.reading_scope: Section 3.2 read in full: magnetic Kerr-Newman-AdS potential, rotating/nonrotating conformal boundary, external electric field in equation 3.72, and charge/stress comparison. Only the metric, potential and boundary-field distinction are used. No hydrodynamic approximation imported into the extremal response proof.

Section 2 equations 1-4: independent dyonic KN-AdS metric, gauge patches, physical charges and horizon angular velocity. Reverse magnetic sign to match our potential. No Schwinger-production or stability conclusion imported.

Appendices A and C reread in full: projected massless Dirac chemical polarization, sphere representation and explicit chiral monopole zero modes. The cosine projection and combined axial source are derived here. The flat-throat angular mass estimate does not replace the coupled AdS boundary calculation.

Appendices A.1 and A.3 reread: KN conventions and scope of the angular uplift without light charged matter. Prior compact-mode comparison retained conditionally; its KN inertia is not substituted for the fixed magnetic boundary-field response.

novelty: The magnetic KN boundary electric field is explicit prior work. The variational interval and necessary-scale comparison are ordinary calculations, without an exhaustive novelty claim.
limitations: Static projected Gaussian response is not the full four-dimensional determinant
Retarded response and compact quantum kernel still require matching
The single-species family passes necessary scale comparisons only
